article.title: Defining Ownership and Acceptance Criteria Across Teams

paragraphs.en: Cross-functional projects often fail not because people lack motivation, but because teams interpret responsibilities differently. A product manager may assume engineering owns data validation, while engineers believe the analytics team will verify the final numbers. Everyone works hard, yet an important check is missed. The solution begins with distinguishing ownership from participation. Several teams can contribute to a task, but one accountable owner should coordinate the decision and confirm that the outcome meets agreed requirements. Clear ownership reduces duplicated effort and prevents work from disappearing between departments. It also makes escalation easier when deadlines or assumptions change.
paragraphs.zh: 跨部門專案失敗往往不是因為缺乏動機，而是對責任理解不同。產品經理以為工程負責資料驗證，工程師卻認為分析團隊會確認數字。大家都努力，重要檢查仍可能漏掉。解法是區分主責與參與：多個團隊可以協作，但應有一位負責人統籌決策並確認成果符合要求。清楚主責能減少重複、避免工作落空，也有助期限或假設改變時升級處理。
paragraphs.ja: 部門横断プロジェクトでは、意欲不足より責任認識の違いが失敗を招きます。製品担当は技術部門が検証すると考え、技術部門は分析担当が確認すると考えることがあります。複数部署が協力しても、結果に責任を持つ担当者を明確にする必要があります。

paragraphs.en: A responsibility matrix can help, but it should not become a ceremonial spreadsheet. For each deliverable, specify who performs the work, who approves the result, who provides necessary input, and who needs to be informed. These roles must correspond to actual authority. Naming someone accountable without giving them access to information or the power to resolve conflicts creates frustration. Teams should review the matrix together and discuss ambiguous boundaries. For example, engineering may own the technical pipeline while finance owns the definition of revenue. Neither can independently guarantee a correct financial dashboard; the acceptance process must connect both responsibilities.
paragraphs.zh: 責任矩陣有幫助，但不該只是形式化試算表。每項交付物需說明執行、核准、提供意見和知會對象，且角色須有實際權限。讓某人負責卻不給資訊或解決衝突的權力只會造成挫折。團隊應共同檢視模糊界線，例如工程負責資料管線、財務負責營收定義；任何一方單獨都無法保證財務儀表板正確，驗收流程必須結合雙方。
paragraphs.ja: 責任分担表では実行、承認、相談、報告の相手を定めます。ただし権限を伴わない責任者の指定は機能しません。技術部門が処理基盤を担当し、財務部門が売上定義を担当する場合、両者を結ぶ受入確認が必要です。

paragraphs.en: Ownership alone does not define success. Teams also need acceptance criteria: observable conditions that determine whether a deliverable is complete. 'Build a reliable report' is too vague because reliability means different things to different readers. A stronger criterion might require that totals reconcile with an approved source, that missing values are reported, and that the report refreshes within a specified window. Criteria should include normal cases, boundary cases, and failure behavior. They should be written before implementation whenever possible. Otherwise, stakeholders may introduce new requirements after delivery and describe the original work as incomplete.
paragraphs.zh: 只有主責還不足以定義成功。團隊也需要可觀察的驗收標準。「做可靠報表」太模糊，因為可靠的意思因人而異。更好的標準可要求總額與核准來源一致、缺失值有揭露、報表在指定時限更新。標準應涵蓋一般、邊界與失敗情況，最好實作前就寫好，否則利害關係人可能交付後才增加要求，反指原工作未完成。
paragraphs.ja: 担当者だけでなく、完了を判定できる受入基準が必要です。「信頼できる報告書」では曖昧です。承認済みデータとの照合、欠損の表示、更新期限、異常時の動作などを実装前に定義します。

paragraphs.en: Dependencies create another source of confusion. A team may promise a delivery date without realizing that it depends on another department approving an interface or supplying a dataset. A useful plan identifies dependencies, their owners, expected dates, and the consequences of delay. Status meetings should focus on decisions and blockers rather than asking everyone to repeat what they did yesterday. When a dependency becomes uncertain, teams can negotiate a smaller scope, change the sequence of work, or escalate the decision. Hiding the risk until the deadline arrives rarely protects relationships; early transparency usually creates more options.
paragraphs.zh: 相依關係也是混亂來源。團隊承諾期限，卻忽略需要其他部門核准介面或提供資料。計畫應標明依賴事項、負責人、預期日期及延誤後果。狀態會議應聚焦決策與阻礙，而非逐人報告昨天做了什麼。相依不確定時，可協商縮小範圍、調整順序或升級決策。隱瞞風險直到截止日通常更傷關係，及早透明能保留選擇。
paragraphs.ja: 他部署の承認やデータ提供への依存を明記します。担当、期限、遅延時の影響を共有し、会議では単なる作業報告より意思決定と障害解消を優先します。問題は早めに伝えた方が対応の選択肢が増えます。

paragraphs.en: A good handoff includes evidence, not merely a message saying that development is finished. The receiving team should know which version was tested, which requirements passed, what limitations remain, and how to reproduce important results. If a defect appears, a documented rollback procedure can prevent further damage. Handoffs are especially important when data crosses system boundaries, because a technically successful transfer may still change business meaning. Teams should verify identifiers, units, time zones, and definitions rather than assuming that matching column names guarantee matching interpretations. Acceptance should be explicit and recorded by the appropriate owner.
paragraphs.zh: 良好交接應包含證據，而不只是「開發完成」。接收團隊應知道測試版本、通過要求、剩餘限制及重現方式。發現缺陷時，有文件化回復程序可避免擴大損害。資料跨系統時尤為重要，因技術傳輸成功仍可能改變業務語意。需核對識別碼、單位、時區和定義，不能因欄名相同就假設意義相同。驗收應由適當負責人明確記錄。
paragraphs.ja: 引き継ぎにはテスト版、合格した条件、残る制約、再現方法を含めます。データ連携では転送成功と業務上の意味の一致は別です。識別子、単位、時刻、定義を確認し、責任者が受入結果を記録します。

paragraphs.en: Finally, responsibility should be revisited when the project changes. A new regulation, supplier, or business objective may make the original allocation obsolete. Short retrospectives can identify recurring confusion and improve future agreements. Leaders should reward people for exposing unclear ownership early rather than blaming them for asking questions. The aim is not to assign fault after something breaks. It is to create a system in which decisions, evidence, and accountability are visible before a problem occurs. When responsibilities and acceptance criteria reinforce each other, cross-functional teams can deliver work that is easier to trust, maintain, and improve.
paragraphs.zh: 最後，專案變更時須重看責任。新法規、供應商或業務目標可能讓原分工過時。簡短回顧可找出反覆模糊之處。主管應鼓勵及早提出主責不清，而不是責怪提問者。目的不是出事後找人究責，而是在事前讓決策、證據與責任可見。當主責和驗收標準相互支持，跨部門成果就更可信、易維護且易改善。
paragraphs.ja: 法規や目標が変われば責任分担も見直します。振り返りで曖昧さを減らし、早期に問題を指摘する行動を評価します。責任と受入基準が結び付くと、信頼できる成果を継続して改善できます。
